T: Run like the wind. Bake like your mum.
D: Two young sprinters from Western Australia sign up and head for Gallipoli.
P: Serve the biscuits when Archy and Frank meet at the athletics carnival.
S: Cairo market hummus and baba ganoush
Chickpea hummus and smoky eggplant dip, flatbread, dukkah, olives, cucumber.

Hummus, baba ganoush and warm flatbread with dukkah, olives and cucumber, a dusting of paprika and plenty of olive oil. Blitz a drained tin of chickpeas with 3 tbsp tahini, lemon, garlic and iced water until silky. Char an eggplant over a flame, scoop and mash with tahini and lemon. Serve with warm flatbreads, dukkah, olives, cucumber, paprika and olive oil.
Corned beef and onion fritters with tomato relish. Bully beef, the Anzac ration.

Mash 340g tinned corned beef with 1 grated onion, 2 eggs, 100g self-raising flour, 125ml milk and pepper into a thick batter. Fry spoonfuls in 3 tbsp oil for 3 minutes a side until crisp and brown. Serve hot with tomato relish.
M: Frank and Archy's Cairo kofta wraps
Spiced lamb in flatbread, garlic yoghurt and sumac onions, on a night's leave before shipping out.

Spiced lamb kofta grilled over high heat, wrapped in warm flatbread with garlic yoghurt, tomato and cucumber salad, pickled chilli and sumac onions. Mix 700g lamb mince with 1 grated onion, 2 garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp coriander, 1 tsp paprika, chopped parsley and salt. Shape onto 8 skewers and chill 30 minutes. Slice 1 red onion and toss with 1 tsp sumac. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with 1 crushed garlic clove and lemon. Dice 2 tomatoes and 1 cucumber. Grill the kofta 8 to 10 minutes, turning. Wrap in 4 warm flatbreads with everything else.
Mena Camp mutton and barley stew
Lamb shoulder, pearl barley and carrots from the dixie.

Brown 1kg diced lamb shoulder in 2 tbsp oil. Add 2 chopped onions, 3 sliced carrots and 2 crushed garlic cloves and soften. Add 150g rinsed pearl barley, 1.25l beef stock, 2 bay leaves and 4 thyme sprigs, then cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours until the lamb is tender and the barley soft. Season well and serve with crusty bread.
W: Little shortcrust tarts filled with plum and apple jam. The tin of jam every Anzac got sick of.

Heat the oven to 190C. Cut 2 sheets of shortcrust pastry into 12 rounds and press into a patty tin. Fill each with a heaped teaspoon of plum and apple jam (about 250g in all). Bake 15 minutes until the pastry is golden. Cool in the tin, then dust with icing sugar.
Crisp oat and coconut biscuits sweetened with golden syrup.
Rolled oats, flour, coconut and sugar mixed with melted butter, golden syrup and bicarb dissolved in boiling water, rolled, flattened, baked at 160C for 15 minutes.
K: Hot black tea with fresh mint and sugar. Bought off the hawkers at the camp gate.
Steep 4 black tea bags and most of a bunch of mint in 1 litre of boiling water for 4 minutes. Remove the tea bags, stir in 4 tbsp sugar and pour into glasses with a mint sprig in each.
